title: Argentinian Haricot Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew inspired by Argentinian cuisine, made with tender haricot beans and a rich, velvety broth.

ingredients.name: Argentinian haricot beans
ingredients.notes: Rinse and drain well before using

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the soaked and drained haricot beans, stew broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
